profile.headline: Lead Software Developer at ScriptDrop
profile.summary:
Idealist full-stack developer looking to meet (and learn from) out-of-the-box thinkers who are building impactful programs that enrich the lives of others.

In my free time, I strive to make the world a more beautiful place, through crafting and design. I'm always on the lookout for powerful connections, obscure sci-fi films and beginner knitting patterns.

positions.title: Software Developer Apprentice
positions.description: Eat, sleep and breath code for 14-weeks. This immersive web development certification program is formalizing my skills in both front-end and back-end languages and technologies.

positions.title: Hive Relationship Manager
positions.description: The Matriots' mission is to elect more Ohio women to public office who will promote a healthy economy in which women can thrive and prosper. I was fortunate to be a part of this transformative PAC during it's infancy. As the Hive Relationship Manager at The Matriots, I integrated donor records to a new Constituent Relationship Management software system by analyzing current vs. preferred data mapping and defining report requirements. I prepared and filed quarterly PAC financial reports with the Ohio Secretary of State’s office and deployed the PAC’s donor acknowledgment and stewardship program to enhance donor loyalty.

positions.title: Assistant Director Donor Relations and Stewardship

company.name: The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center

positions.title: Donor Relations Coordinator
positions.description:
I have the privilege to thank a group of amazing people for changing lives through their unending generosity. With pictures and words I share the stories of families struggling to make ends meet. Because hunger can happen to anybody.

I manage Pledge Partners, Mid-Ohio Foodbank's monthly giving program. I build relationships, create mailings, build reports, take pictures, get innovative, and have a blast.

positions.title: Food Pantry Coordinator
positions.description: Coordinate the daily activities of the Mid-Ohio Foodbank onsite food pantry, including food ordering, volunteer management, and program evaluation.

positions.title: Agency Services Representative
positions.description: Enhanced agency satisfaction with Mid-Ohio Foodbank by offering well-informed and timely information regarding ordering practices, product descriptions, and delivery timelines.

positions.title: Volunteer and Donations Coordinator
positions.description: Oversaw the acceptance and redistribution of material donations at the YWCA Family Shelter. Coordinated volunteer projects by leading volunteer groups through various service projects.

positions.title: AmeriCorps Member
positions.description: Designed and implemented educational cooking demonstrations, in collaboration with Cooking Caravan, for the wider community. Worked with a team in developing an organizational strategy to increase hunger awareness in Mid-Ohio Foodbank's service area.

certifications.name: Chase Gen Y Leadership Project Class IV
certifications.title: Chase Gen Y Leadership Project Class IV

volunteerExperiences.description: Working with Zipzone and Hocking Hills Canopy Tours, I assisted children and adults sign waivers to ride the indoor and outdoor ziplines at the 2016 Arnold Sports Festival Kids Fest!
I worked with clients to complete the Ohio HIV Drug Assistance Application and other office duties as assigned
